about_the_game:
Live Wallpaper is a desktop customization software designed specifically for PC users. The app delivers the latest high-definition live wallpapers and offers thousands of premium-quality wallpapers. Whether you're after the trendiest picks or prefer exploring wallpapers by category, you’ll find exactly what you’re looking for here. Don’t miss the chance to give your desktop a refreshing new look!

Unique Features:

1. Massive Library, Free to Explore

Live Wallpaper offers thousands of HD wallpapers across 12 diverse categories—from ultra-clear 4K and anime, to stylish girls, natural landscapes, AI characters, cute pets, cyberpunk gaming themes, soothing freshness, sci-fi CG, creative text-based designs, and eye-friendly green tones. Whether you like minimalist elegance or bold personality, there's something here to match your taste and make your desktop truly unique.

2. One-Click Change, Quick & Easy

Say goodbye to complicated wallpaper setups. With Live Wallpaper’s one-click switch feature, changing your desktop background takes just a second. Whether it's based on your mood, time of day, or seasonal vibe, you can instantly refresh your wallpaper and widgets, keeping your desktop lively and inspiring.

3. Clean Interface, Smooth Experience

Following a user-friendly design philosophy and inspired by solutions like Wallpaper Engine, Live Wallpaper ensures ease of use for everyone—even beginners. Quickly browse, preview, and apply wallpapers with zero hassle. It’s all about a smooth, comfortable experience that lets you focus on the joy of visual discovery.

4. Premium Quality, Crystal Clear Display

Every wallpaper in Live Wallpaper is carefully curated and strictly reviewed. Enjoy ultra-HD (4K) resolution, vivid colors, and excellent clarity. Partnering with top photographers, designers, and popular IPs, we continuously update our content so your desktop always feels fresh and exciting.

Live Wallpaper is more than just a wallpaper app—it's a window into your personality and attitude. Every day brings a new surprise! Download now and start your desktop beautification journey!

name: Live Wallpaper

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: 1.66 GHz Intel i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
  • Graphics: HD Graphics 4000 or above
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Intel i7 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660, AMD HD7870, 2 GB VRAM or above
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space

short_description: Live Wallpaper is a desktop beautification software, offering thousands of HD dynamic and static wallpapers across 12 categories—from 4K landscapes and anime to futuristic CG and adorable pets. With one-click switching, and optimized performance, you can personalize your desktop effortlessly.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Thai, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Vietnamese, Arabic
